title: api/v1/series.json
description: Every series, one row each, sorted by series_id. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; a monthly or quarterly value is dated by the last day of its period.

series_id.description: Frozen: an id is never renamed or reused.

title_ar_source.description: Who wrote the Arabic title when CBE did not, e.g. miqyas.

family.description: Grouping for browsing. New families can appear.

freq.description: D, W, BW, M, Q, A or IRR (irregular). New codes can appear.

previous.description: The value before latest_value; null for a one-point series.

biggest_move.description: Optional. The largest single step in the series.

stale_days.description: Optional. Days past the series's own rhythm with no new value.

zero_values.description: Optional. How many observations are exactly zero.

flags.description: Optional. Other data-quality notes, in English.
